description: One report on a business partner before invoicing or delivering: VAT ID (VIES or Swiss UID register), EORI customs number (the given one, or the VAT ID tried as EORI), Peppol e-invoicing (per identifier, whether the provider's SMP lists a recognised invoice type; this does not prove delivery), and LEI with parent company. Each part names its own source and time and has its own status; a part whose source is down says so without affecting the others. No sanctions screening.

eori.description: Optional: the partner's EORI number, if different from the VAT ID.

name.description: Optional: the partner's name, used for the LEI search when the register publishes none.

requester_vat_id.description: Optional: the user's OWN EU VAT ID. If given and accepted by VIES, a valid EU VAT ID is answered with a consultation number as official proof of the check (not for Swiss UIDs). Only pass it when the user provided their own VAT ID for this purpose.

vat_id.description: The partner's VAT ID or Swiss UID.

name: check_business_partner
title: Check business partner
